title: Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Off-policy and on-policy distillation have traditionally been formulated as separate paradigms, each favoring a different property of distillation trajectories. Teacher-generated (off-policy) traces are typically high-quality but lie far from the student's distribution, whereas student-generated (on-policy) rollouts are more learnable but often contain erroneous reasoning. We view these paradigms as the endpoints of a policy continuum and posit that a more effective rollout policy may lie in between. We introduce \textbf{Interpolated Policy Distillation (IPD)}, which defines the next-token distribution at every decoding step as an explicit linear interpolation between the student and teacher distributions. The interpolation operates at the distribution level, token by token, and its coefficient provides direct control over the balance between trajectory quality and student learnability. translated_title: 插值策略蒸馏：在离策略蒸馏与在策略蒸馏之间的可控连续统
translated_abstract: 离策略蒸馏和在策略蒸馏传统上被表述为两种独立的范式，各自侧重于蒸馏轨迹的不同属性。教师生成的（离策略）轨迹通常质量较高，但距离学生的分布较远；而学生生成的（在策略）展开轨迹更易于学习，但往往包含错误的推理。我们将这两种范式视为策略连续统的两个端点，并提出一种更有效的展开策略可能位于两者之间。我们提出了插值策略蒸馏（Interpolated Policy Distillation，IPD），它在每个解码步骤将下一个词元的分布定义为学生分布与教师分布之间的显式线性插值。该插值在分布层面逐词元进行，其插值系数可以直接控制轨迹质量与学生可学习性之间的平衡。直接从该策略中采样将需要……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出插值策略蒸馏（IPD），通过在每个解码步骤对学生分布与教师分布进行逐词元的显式线性插值，构建了离策略与在策略蒸馏之间的可控连续统，其插值系数可直接调节轨迹质量与学生可学习性之间的平衡。
